data: What is the approximate BLEU score of the red line at 10 ms/word in the left graph?

The red line represents ACP-SN, and the blue line represents NCP-SN. The x-axis shows the decoding speed in ms/word, and the y-axis shows the BLEU score. At approximately 10 ms/word, the red line (ACP-SN) is slightly above the blue line (NCP-SN). The approximate BLEU score of the red line at this point is around 37.
